args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information
- Medications and prescriptions

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and shopping
- Light jacket or sweater for evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Water shoes for snorkeling
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Reusable water bottle

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts (sun protection)
- Rain jacket or poncho
- Daypack/backpack
- Insect repellent

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Pearl Harbor: Respectful attire (covered shoulders, no shorts)
- Luau: Optional aloha shirt or dress
- Spa day: Robe (though hotel may provide)
- Shopping: Reusable shopping bags

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Hairbrush/comb
- Travel laundry detergent
- Small first aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (if required)
- Books or e-reader for downtime
- Travel pillow and eye mask for flights

REMEMBER:
- Check luggage weight restrictions
- Verify if any activities require advance reservations
- Download offline maps of Hawaii
- Save emergency contacts
